Author: NightmareXIV
Name: Stylist
Description: Gear manager that will watch your gearset for possible upgrades and upgrade them via single command.
Changelog: Validated fork update from source 44f132d4d744dc8c379449460762d029d9bc8fd4. Storage reconciliation now uses the same all-saved-gearsets and equipped-item membership rule as Steward, including unchanged sets and items already in regular inventory. Referenced items move to the armory; unreferenced armory items move to inventory. HQ and appearance differences do not remove membership. Uses the original Stylist emblem recoloured in the fork-family green-to-magenta palette. Build, storage, merge-policy and package checks passed. Existing IPC identity is preserved. Development preview; native UI acceptance testing remains separate.
